value.rationale: For a canonical small planar cubic graph, the natural shortest embedded homology spheres supply a complete intrinsic integral generating set and a natural nine-orbit lattice stratification. An individual primitiveness property coexists with an index-three obstruction for one full group orbit. This distinguishes symmetry-local from global integral generation, is not a generic graph substitution, and creates a reproducible test case for matching-complex integral homology.
